body.message:
We would like to inform you that this unit is not available for viewing today, as there is currently an in-house guest who is scheduled to check out on 20th August.

Subject to the guest not extending their stay and no new bookings being received for the unit, we may be able to arrange a viewing after the check-out date.

In the meantime, could you please let us know how long you are looking to rent the unit? This will help us check the availability and suitable options for you.
